title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Levothyroxin, ATC H03AA01 für die Zeit 01.04.2026 - 31.03.2028 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate)
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff Levothyroxin, ATC H03AA01, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.04.2026 in Kraft und endet am 31.03.2028 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate). Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: Serviciu de configurare si punere in functiune sistem VSAT ORBIT OCEAN TRX4-500 la nava PM274
description: Ofertarea si prestarea serviciului de configurare si punere in functiune sistem VSAT ORBIT OCEAN TRX4-500 la nava PM274 se face in baza caietului de sarcini atasat. Termenul de prestare - maxim 2 zile de la data transmiterii comenzii dar nu mai tarziu de 20.06.2024. Plata se va face prin Trezorerie, in termen de max 60 zile de la receptia serviciului si emiterea facturii elecronice prin platforma ANAF RO e-Factura, conform Legii nr. 139/2022, art.II. Oferta va cuprinde obligatoriu : formularul de oferta, centralizatorul de preturi (defalcat pe materiale si manopera), propunere tehnica (care va cuprinde punct cu punct comentariul la caietul de sarcini), grafic de timp pentru efectuarea serviciului. Termen de executie maxim 2 zile de la data transmiterii comenzii dar nu mai tarziu de 20.06.2024. Pe timpul lucrarilor nava va fi stationata in portul militar Constanța. Pretul cel mai mic. Oferta va fi depusa pe adresa pe e-mail achizitiium02049@navy.ro.

title: Acquisition et installation d'équipements et accessoires pour les formations « Métiers carrossier peintre automobile » du Lycée Blaise Pascal de FORBACH (57)
description: Acquisition et installation d'équipements et accessoires pour les formations « Métiers carrossier peintre automobile » du Lycée Blaise Pascal de FORBACH (57) | Le marché objet de la consultation vise l'acquisition et l'installation d'équipements et accessoires pour la préparation et l'application des peintures automobile concernant les formations Métiers carrossier peintre automobile du Lycée Blaise Pascal de FORBACH. Le projet consiste en la mise à niveau du plateau technique de l'atelier AT1 du Lycée Blaise Pascal, à la suite du transfert des formations du Lycée professionnel Hurlevent de Behren-lès-Forbach, qui fermera en juillet 2027. Le marché comprend la fourniture, la livraison, l'installation et la mise en ordre de marche des équipements et accessoires, la reprise des emballages ainsi que la formation sur site associés des personnels utilisateurs encadrants. La cabine de peinture, l'aire de préparation 2 postes avec compensation chauffée, la centrale d'aspiration de ponçage reliée à 6 satellites multi-énergies et les équipements d'un laboratoire de préparation et nettoyage sont destinés à la formation des lycéens, des apprentis, des étudiants et stagiaires de formation continue des cursus suivants : CAP spécialité « Peintre automobile » et Baccalauréat professionnel spécialité « Carrossier peinture automobile » et tout autre cursus dans les domaines des métiers de la préparation et l'application des peintures automobile. Ces machines sont destinées à l'apprentissage des méthodes et des procédés d'opérations de préparation des surfaces avant peinture (masticage, ponçage, marouflage et séchage) et de la réalisation de peinture sur carrosserie automobile. Leurs usages sont principalement à vocation pédagogique, cependant, les équipements et accessoires proposés doivent être en tout point semblables aux machines utilisées dans les ateliers de réparation et de peinture de carrosseries. Les équipements et accessoires proposés seront neufs. Une garantie de 24 mois pièces et main d'oeuvre est exigée. Le marché sera conclu à prix global et forfaitaire avec un seul opérateur économique (marché simple) | La valeur totale correspond au montant maximum sur la durée du marché. Le montant Ht correspond au montant simulé de l'offre du titulaire sur la durée du marché. Les pièces du marché sont consultables dans les conditions de droit commun (notamment sous réserve de la préservation des intérêts commerciaux de l'entreprise attributaire) sur demande écrite à l'adresse : Région Grand Est, Direction de l'Achat Public, Place Gabriel Hocquard, Cs 80004, 57036 Metz Cedex Introduction de recours : Le candidat peut s'il le souhaite, exercer devant le Tribunal Administratif compétent ; un référé contractuel dans un délai de 31 jours à compter de la publication d'un avis d'attribution, ou à défaut de la publication, 6 mois à compter de la signature du contrat (articles L551-13 et suivants et R551-7 et suivants), un recours en annulation contre le marché dans les 2 mois suivant la date à laquelle la conclusion du contrat a été rendue publique

title: Purchase of benchtop NMR spectrometer
description: DTU intends to purchase an X-Pulse Benchtop NMR Spectrometer from Oxford Instruments GmbH based on the following. The research in the Magnetic Resonance and Electrochemistry Lab at DTU Chemistry, a benchtop nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectrometer is required. This spectrometer requires some specific characteristics for the specific research needs of the group: full broadband tuneability, pulsed-field gradients (PFG), operando capabilities, and temperature control. It is also important that the probes are user-accessible so they can be easily serviced and upgraded as necessary with modular hardware. Further, the experiments should be modifiable such that NMR methods can be altered and developed according to the group’s specific needs. Broadband tuneability: The instrument should be completely broadband tuneable (not limited to a fixed number), specifically to 1H, 13C, 31P, 19F, and 23Na and should also include low-gamma nu-clides such as 35Cl, 17O, and 6Li; multiple nuclides should be able to be tuned simultaneously. Pulsed-field gradients: The instrument requires PFG capability in order to perform the specific transport experiments intended by the group. Gradients of at least 0.5 T/m are necessary to achieve appropriate spatial resolution as well as being able to probe electrolyte transport with PFG-NMR. Operando capabilities: The spectrometer probe should be removable by general users without a need for specialised tools and should be generally accessible to facilitate operando experimental setups. This spectrometer should be easy to transport for online monitoring of experiments via a flow system. The system should also be able to integrate peripheral devices that can be triggered during the experiments. A hardware lock is preferable to maintain high-quality experiments in operando. Temperature control: The temperature of the sample must be adjustable independently and de-coupled from the magnet temperature. Wide temperature control is needed to probe different conditions of battery operation, from freezing temperatures to electrolyte breakdown temperatures, enabling the study of operation at extreme conditions and the effects of storage temperatures. Direct heating to sample Experiment development: The system should enable modification of NMR experiments (pulse sequences) for method development. This unique combination of capability is required for the group’s particular research intentions to study battery electrolytes in situ using combinations of magnetic resonance imaging, and holistic analytical chemistry. This includes operating electrochemical cells within the magnet, and monitoring electrolyte salts and solvents, as well as diffusion characteristics throughout these experiments. There are very few available benchtop NMR spectrometers on the market. The main vendors are Bruker, Oxford, and Magritek. Other vendors generally lack modification capabilities as they are targeted at operators rather than expert users. Of the named vendors, only the X-Pulse system from Oxford Instruments meets the specific combination of technical requirements of the group, which are: 1) Complete broadband tuneability, including to low-gamma nuclides, with no limit on number 2) Pulsed-field gradient capabilities with gradient strengths >0.5 T/m 3) Integrated chemically resistant flow setup for online monitoring 4) Easily accessible and removable probe, enabling simple maintenance and upgradability 5) Hardware 2H locking system for consistent lock without the need for deuterated solvents 6) Easy-to-move system for relocation to experimental setups 7) Wide temperature control (0-65 °C) covering temperatures relevant for monitoring battery processes While the competitor products may offer a selection of these capabilities, their instruments do not have the specific combination of technical specifications required for the intended work. Therefore, the Oxford Instruments X-Pulse system is the only system that can meet all the necessary requirements for the group’s intended needs. title: Denmark – Security, fire-fighting, police and defence equipment – Marked dialogue regarding underwater sensor and payloade package
description: The Danish Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is preparing the procurement of a comprehensive sensor and payload package for a Strategic Infrastructure Surveillance Vessel. DALO has acquired the offshore support vessel Norwind Helm, which will undergo conversion expectedly in Q4 2026 to fulfil its new operational role within the Royal Danish Navy. The conversion will include integration of advanced surveillance, and subsea capabilities. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued to engage with the market and obtain relevant information regarding: • Available technical solutions • Integration approaches • Commercial and contractual structures • Market capabilities and constraints • Delivery timelines and risk factors Participation in this RFI is voluntary. Non-participation will not affect eligibility in any future procurement. Procurement Intent DALO’s current preference is for a single prime contractor delivering a turnkey solution, including: • System design and architecture • Integration of sensors and payloads • Procurement of sensors and other equipment (ROV and AUVs) • Integration of existing onboard systems where applicable • Testing, validation and commissioning • Documentation and lifecycle support Alternative commercial models may be considered if clearly justified. Desired Supplier Profile Suppliers should demonstrate: • Supplier Facility Security Clearance level • Supplier Personnel Security Clearance level • Sensor- and payload-agnostic system architecture • Proven experience operating surface and subsea platforms • Proven delivery and use of sensor and payload package to allied navies. • End-to-end in-house capabilities (design, manufacturing, testing, simulation) • Operational delivery of seabed-to-space payload solutions • Training and maintenance • Demonstrated lifecycle cost efficiency Mission Definition & Multi-Mission Capability Solutions should support: • Critical Underwater Infrastructure (CUI) inspection • Mine Countermeasure (MCM) route inspection • Patrol and persistent presence operations • System architecture modularity and configurability. Operational Parameters Suppliers should demonstrate adaptability to: • Danish body of waters • Varying water depths and seabed conditions • Mission frequency and repetition cycles • Environmental protection and HSE requirements Sensor Deployment & Operations Describe: • On-vessel sensor deployment concepts • ROV/AUV launch and recovery systems • Containerised vs permanent installations • Hoist, overside, & moon-pool installation options. • Future integration of additional unmanned platforms Impact on Vessel Design Explain how payloads influence: • Stability and weight distribution • Power generation requirements • Battery safety management (AUV) • Data infrastructure and operator spaces Data Requirements Outline: • ROV/AUV navigational & sensor accuracy levels per mission type • Coverage rate and efficiency • Data density and resolution • Sampling capability where applicable Data Handling & Interoperability Provide details regarding: • Raw vs processed data outputs • Reporting and analytical products • Cloud infrastructure options • Interoperability with Royal Danish Navy systems • Access levels (onboard, remote, shore-based) Cybersecurity & Information Assurance Detail compliance with defence cybersecurity standards including: • Encryption protocols • Secure communications architecture • System hardening • Network segmentation • Data sovereignty compliance

description: Die Baumaßnahme umfasst die Sanierung und Erweiterung der Grundschule Wagenstadt in Herbolzheim. Das bestehende dreigeschossige Schulgebäude wird bis auf den Rohbau entkernt und umfassend saniert. Zusätzlich entstehen ein neuer südlicher Anbau, ein Aufzug über alle Geschosse sowie ein neues Treppenhaus als zweiter Rettungsweg. Im Zuge der Sanitärarbeiten werden sämtliche Sanitärobjekte, Trinkwasser- und Abwasserinstallationen einschließlich Leitungsdämmung, Brandschutzabschottungen und Nebenleistungen erneuert bzw. neu hergestellt. Die Leistungen umfassen unter anderem die Installation von WC-Anlagen einschließlich barrierefreiem WC, Urinalen, Waschbecken, Ausgussbecken, Trinkwasserleitungen aus Edelstahl, schallgedämmten Schmutzwasserleitungen, Außenwasserleitungen, Rohrdämmungen sowie die Inbetriebnahme, Spülung, Beprobung und Dokumentation der Anlagen. title: Ireland – Repair and maintenance services of motorcycles – Request for Tenders dated 01/10/2026 for the provision of maintenance services for Met Eireann’s environmental monitoring instrumentation and related infrastructure at Bray Head, Valentia Island
description: Met Éireann has committed significant resources to its programmes that support Ireland’s Atmospheric Composition and Climate Change (AC3) network and national research and monitoring infrastructure. These resources include buildings, equipment and staff that espouse international coordinated programmes which include; the Global Atmosphere Watch (GAW) Programme, the “European Monitoring and Evaluation Programme” (EMEP), Integrated Carbon Observation System (ICOS) and GHG emissions and Short Lived Climate Forcers (SLCF) monitoring. These programmes have developed incrementally and have adhered to best practice from pan-European and global monitoring programmes. Details of some of these programmes are included in Appendix 1 of the RFT. Met Éireann has a dedicated facility at Bray Head on Valentia Island, which is shortly to be verified as an ICOS Class 2 site, which hosts monitoring equipment for monitoring atmospheric gases and aerosols. The data can also be used for emissions verification, through an inverse modelling process, of greenhouse gases and pollutants and facilitate the calculation of Ireland’s emissions and Ireland’s greenhouse gas inventories and projections. The tender relates to the provision of support services, data validation, calibration and maintenance for some of the instrumentation and associated data streams.
